# `fr_docket_links`

Exploded Federal Register-to-regulations.gov link table: one row per Federal Register document and referenced docket. It is the normalized bridge used by `rule_targets`, proceedings, and comment periods.

- **Parquet file:** `fr_docket_links.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docket_id` | `VARCHAR` | Referenced regulations.gov docket identifier. |
| `docket_key` | `VARCHAR` | Comparison key for `docket_id`: leading Federal Register docket decorations stripped, internal whitespace repaired, upper-cased. A key, not a resolution — it says what to compare against, never which docket a row names. A key matching more than one docket is a collision the consumer quarantines rather than resolves. Null when nothing survives normalization. |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register document number. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register document title. |
| `abstract` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register abstract. |
| `document_type` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register category such as `Rule` or `Proposed Rule`. |
| `subtype` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register subtype, when present. |
| `publication_date` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register publication date. |
| `effective_on` | `VARCHAR` | Effective date, when stated. |
| `comments_close_on` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register comment deadline, when stated. |
| `signing_date` | `VARCHAR` | Signing date for presidential documents. |
| `agency_slugs` | `VARCHAR` | Comma-separated Federal Register agency slugs. |
| `docket_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original JSON docket-id array retained for compatibility. |
| `regulation_id_numbers_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of RINs reported by the Federal Register document. |
| `html_url` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register HTML page. |
| `pdf_url` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register PDF rendition. |
| `executive_order_number` | `VARCHAR` | Executive-order number, when applicable. |
